en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European town taken from an elevated, wooded vantage point. In the foreground are dense trees; beyond them lies a compact town with traditional gabled roofs and prominent church towers, one especially tall on the right. Open fields and gently rolling countryside stretch into the distance under a cloudy sky. A printed caption in German appears along the bottom edge.
